title: Implement Design With Diff Across Languages
description: Define designWithDiff(design:Design, designDiff:DesignDiff): Design across all five language ports (JS, Go, Python, Rust, .NET). The function maintains all old pieces and connections with their original parameters, annotates each with a compose.diffStatus attribute (unchanged/modified/removed/added), keeps deleted pieces/connections in place marked as removed, and appends added entities marked as added. Add a nakagin-capsule-tower.with-diff.design.compose.json asset, export it from assets/index.ts, and add Design/WithDiff tests in every port.
summary:
Implemented `designWithDiff` across all five languages (JS, Go, Python, Rust, .NET) and added tests for each. Also fixed Rust `DesignDiff` deserialization by adding `#[serde(default)]` to the `guid` field.

- JS: Added `designWithDiff` function in `compose/js/index.ts` and test in `describe("Design/WithDiff")`
- Go: Added `DesignWithDiff` function in `compose/go/compose.go` and `TestDesignWithDiff` in `compose_test.go`
- Python: Added `designWithDiffDict` function in `compose/py/main.py` and `TestDesignWithDiff` class
- Rust: Added `design_with_diff` function in `compose/rs/lib.rs`, test in `mod with_diff`, fixed `DesignDiff.guid` with `#[serde(default)]`
- .NET: Added `Design.WithDiff` static method in `Compose.cs` and test in `Tests.cs`
- Asset: Generated `nakagin-capsule-tower.with-diff.design.compose.json` (185 pieces, 183 connections with status annotations)
- Exports: Added `NakaginCapsuleTowerDiffDesign` and `NakaginCapsuleTowerWithDiffDesign` to `assets/index.ts`

All new tests pass. Pre-existing failures (KitWorkflow roundtrip, SQLite) are unrelated.
